one_line: Low-code relational database that blends spreadsheets with app-building.
auth_notes: Modern Web API uses OAuth2 or personal access tokens (Bearer); legacy API keys still function. Token scopes restrict base/table access.
self_serve_notes: Free tier available; any developer can generate a PAT free and solo in the Airtable account UI.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Bases, tables, records, fields, attachments, comments, webhooks, automations — full CRUD over base content.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks API for base changes with payload curation support.

existing_mcp.note: Official Airtable MCP server exists (airtable/airtable-mcp); community servers also exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text is the Airtable Web API intro confirming REST semantics, JSON, and official JS client; auth details from knowledge plus official docs URL.
